summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper (imports only os and json; no type hints, per the spec's "none do" option). Exported it explicitly in monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection to docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and created tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, and test_seg_no_labels. Nothing was run, since tests, black, and flake8 were not executed per instructions, so those checks are unverified. No commits were made.
